blocks.text: Check out this page for live updates on Miss Grand International 2026 The “golden crown” has found its new queen as Jihan Dimack of Tanzania was proclaimed Miss Grand International 2026 at the conclusion of the “Grand Final” in Thailand on Saturday evening, Oct. 10. Dimack bested 75 other aspirants from around the world to inherit the crown from Filipino queen Emma Tiglao, last year’s winner, in ceremonies held at the MGI Hall at Bravo BKK in Bangkok. Settling for the first runner-up spot was Shyare Andrade from Ecuador, while Beau Megan Goos from Netherlands was proclaimed second runner-up. Ximena Carrillo […]...
